responsibility: Implements GCC’s dump and optimization-report infrastructure behind the dumpfile API. This file owns the global dump streams and flags, the registry of dump kinds and -fdump-* switch metadata, parsing and filtering of dump/options groups and -fopt-info verbosity, dump_manager behavior for registering/opening/naming/finalizing per-pass dump files, and the formatted emission paths that route dump_* calls to plain dump files, alternate opt-info streams, and structured optinfo/JSON recording contexts with scope and location handling.
same_name_distinction: This is the dumpfile group's implementation file: it owns the dump/opt-info globals, switch and flag tables, dump_manager behavior, stream opening/naming/finalization, option parsing, and formatted emission logic. Unlike dumpfile.h, which declares the enums, flags, types, and APIs, this file provides the concrete state and runtime behavior behind them.
